author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Add Phase-2 HCAL-only workflows running over TTbar, without and without pileup:
  - `.422` any backend (cpu or gpu), including DQM and validation
  - `.423` gpu vs cpu validation
  - `.424` any backend, trimmed down for profiling

#### PR validation:

The new workflows pass.
title: Add Phase-2 HCAL-only workflows
